ruleDefinitions.name: Rundll32 Execution With Uncommon DLL Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of rundll32 with a command line that doesn't contain a common extension

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND  NOT (process_command_line = "None" OR process_command_line = "" OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl\\,.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\,.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.inf\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.inf\\,.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.inf\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.inf\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.cpl$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.inf$"))) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-localserver\\ .*") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Installer\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*zzzzInvokeManagedCustomActionOutOfProc.*")))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeUpdate\\\\Install\\\\\\{.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\EDGEMITMP\\_.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\setup\\\.exe.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-install\\-archive\\=.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-previous\\-version\\=.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-msedgewebview\\ \\-\\-verbose\\-logging\\ \\-\\-do\\-not\\-launch\\-msedge\\ \\-\\-user\\-level.*")))
